messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: P1 — embedding errors spike in eu-west-1 on /v1/embeddings. Triggering oncall @emma. Error class: 502 gateway / embed-gateway.
emma (oncall): I'm on it, triaging now. Initial look shows 502s from embed-gateway behind embed-eu-01. QPS spike + some nodes stuck in Init. @rashid can you check the model-serving pool and autoscaler?
rashid: digging in — autoscaler scaled earlier but 4/6 pods failed to finish init, OOM on quantized shard during KV restore. Kicking restart on the node group embed-eu-01 and draining pods on bad hosts.
emma (oncall): Noted. Customer impact: 1) Calypso Finance (acct-CAL-101) — high traffic, 2) Helion Labs (acct-HEL-204) — Dedicated with fallback preferences, 3) RiverRun (acct-RIV-330) — lower priority. Samir, can you take primary contact for Calypso (call + follow-up email)? :phone: :white_check_mark:
samir (CSE): Taking Calypso. Calling their SRE now. Will post call notes and send the tailored email. Draft below — please review.
```
Subject: [Redwood] Incident: EU embeddings errors — Calypso impact & mitigations
Hi <Calypso SRE>,
We're seeing increased 502s for embedding requests serving eu-west-1 between 14:02–14:20 UTC. We're actively restarting affected node group and routing traffic to eu-central fallback while we validate.
What this means for you: transient 5xxs and increased latencies for some embedding calls. Dedicated fallback enabled where configured.
Next steps: we expect verification within ~30 minutes and will update you on full restore. If you see continued errors, please reply or call our on-call at +1-xxx-xxx-xxxx.
Thanks,
Samir (Redwood CSE)
```
lina (ops-liaison): Status page draft (short):
```
Incident: Embeddings errors in EU region
Impact: Some customers in eu-west-1 may see 5xx errors and elevated latencies for embedding requests.
Status: Mitigation in progress — routing to eu-central and restarting embed-eu-01 node group.
ETA: 30 minutes for verification.
```
emma (oncall): Mitigation plan executed: 1) Restarted embed-eu-01 node group (rolling restarts), 2) Enabled routing fallback to eu-central for production tenants and lightweight model `embed-light-v2` for Dedicated tenants for up to 30m, 3) Monitoring p50/p95 and 5xx rate.
rashid: Restart finished on 4/6 problematic nodes, KV cache warm-up in progress. 5xx rate down from ~28% -> ~3% over last 6m. p95 latency trending down. Continuing verification.
deploy-bot: restart embed-eu-01 — success (4/6 nodes). Ticket INC-3276 created.
emma (oncall): Oncall handoff scheduled: handing to @lina at 14:30 UTC for monitoring and customer comms (I'll stay available if anything regresses). Notes added to the incident: restart, fallback routing enabled, affected accounts (CAL-101, HEL-204, RIV-330).
lina (ops-liaison): Acknowledged. I'll post the status page update and send the tailored Calypso note after Samir confirms call outcome. I'll also trigger customer-notify channel for signoff.
samir (CSE): Calypso call done — they saw ~30% failures between 14:02–14:18 UTC. They accepted our fallback and routing. Asked for ETA for full restore; I quoted ~30m for verification. They requested a brief post-restore summary.
emma (oncall): Great. Plan: Lina posts status now, Samir sends Calypso follow-up, and we'll keep monitoring. If errors stay <5% for 15m, we'll close the incident and send final customer notes.
lina (ops-liaison): Posting status page update and queueing targeted emails now. I'll drop the customer notify snippets in #customer-notify for final approvals. :thumbsup:
